About us: 
 Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂
 Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.
 Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.
 The Role: 
 We are looking for a Senior Frontend Developer to join one of our high-growth client teams as a core frontend architect. In this role, you will lead the evolution of the client's user interfaces, moving beyond simple feature delivery to build highly performant, accessible, and scalable web applications.
 You will be the technical anchor for the frontend team, ensuring that the application architecture leverages the full power of modern Vue. Your focus will be on creating predictable state patterns, optimizing bundle sizes, and establishing a robust component library that elevates the user experience. This is a role for an engineer who views the frontend as a critical, enterprise-grade software system.
 What we are looking for: 
5+ years of dedicated frontend experience, with deep, hands-on mastery of Vue 3 (Composition API) and its reactivity model.
Strong experience writing clean, type-safe code within large-scale Vue applications.
Advanced knowledge of Pinia (or highly structured Vuex architectures) for managing complex, asynchronous global states.
Deep familiarity with modern build chains, specifically Vite, including configuration, code-splitting strategies, and dependency optimization.
Experience implementing responsive UI using Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or advanced SASS/SCSS, matching exact design specs from Figma.
Experience establishing frontend testing strategies using Vitest, Vue Test Utils, or End-to-End frameworks like Playwright/Cypress.
Proven track record of optimizing Core Web Vitals, managing lazy loading, and diagnosing rendering bottlenecks.
Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.
 Nice-to-have: 
Production experience with Server-Side Rendering (SSR) via Nuxt.js.
Familiarity with Micro-Frontend architectures and module federation.
Deep understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and semantic HTML.
Experience with automated CI/CD deployment pipelines for frontend assets.
 Responsibilities: 
Architect and implement complex, interactive user interfaces from scratch using Vue 3 and TypeScript.
Design and maintain a highly reusable, documented component library to unify the product ecosystem.
Audit and refactor existing codebases to maximize application speed, responsiveness, and SEO health.
Lead architectural decisions, establish linting/formatting standards, and conduct strict, constructive code reviews.
Partner closely with Product Owners, UX/UI Designers, and Backend Engineers to define explicit API contracts and user flows.
